Comment.value: Crash Party event item. Plot+Cursed on purpose: undroppable, unsellable, unstealable, unbankable. Cursed means 'cannot be dropped' only, so a worn one can still be taken off. Charges live in the CP_USES item local (cp_inc.nss) and are never shown to the player. WORN item: dispatched by cp_equip.nss / cp_unequip.nss, which is a cp_-only hook rather than the module-wide x2_mod_def_equ. One charge per EQUIP.

value.0:
A lopsided circlet hung with small bells, whistles and at least one unidentifiable animal. It is never entirely quiet, and it is never quiet in the same way twice.

Wear it. That is all it asks.
